# Members who should NOT appear in the grid at the bottom of the org profile README.
#
# The grid lists every organization member, including those whose GitHub
# membership visibility is private. If you would rather not be listed, add your
# username below (one per line) and the next scheduled run drops you. Opening a
# PR against this file is enough, or ask an admin to add you.
#
# Anything after a # is ignored, and matching is case-insensitive.
#
# Example:
#   some-username
